title: UFO over a big game in Italy
summary: James Fox tells of UFO over a big game in Italy, about 1950s (c. 1957) at Italy, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like in the 50s uh 57 I think in uh Italy some big

plain: A documentary filmmaker named James Fox mentions a UFO sighting in Italy in the 1950s, around 1957 as he remembers it, over some big game where many people were watching. He gives only a passing mention, as an example of a sighting seen by a large crowd.
